data_gaps: Brave Search returned HTTP 429 (plan rate_limit = 1 req/sec, Free tier) on the third of three concurrent review-mining calls (devouritcatering.com.au). Retried serially and COMPLETED — no review-mining data was lost. Future Phase-1 runs must issue Brave calls one at a time, not in the 3-wide batches used for DataForSEO.

GSC: the first pull (rowLimit=2000, default sort by clicks) silently truncated inside the zero-click tier — 1,718 of 2,000 rows had 0 clicks and the highest-impression 0-click row was 681 impressions, proving cut-off. Re-pulled at rowLimit=25000 and got the complete set (5,672 queries, min impressions 1). The 1,316 queries at impressions>=10 are therefore complete, NOT capped. No GSC outage occurred; the property answered every call.

DataForSEO returned no search_volume for most Melbourne-qualified long-tail candidates (e.g. 'boardroom catering melbourne', 'workplace catering melbourne'). Consistent with the Phase-0 finding: these sit below the DFS reporting threshold and are UNMEASURED, not zero demand. 147 of 232 candidates (63%) carry GSC and/or DFS evidence; the remaining 85 are deliberate service-taxonomy coverage of Q10 lines that must be measured in Phase 3a.

SE Ranking PROJECT_* remains unregistered in this session (pre-existing Phase-0 gap). Not needed for Phase 1 — the tracked-50 universe was read from the staged raw/seranking-existing-keywords.json, which reconciles 50/50 with config.
analyst_notes: COLLISION: the Phase-0 allocation candidate 'melbourne catering company' (tier_a, existing_page_optimisation, GSC pos 6.87 / 259 impr) is a word-order + plural variant of the ALREADY-TRACKED 'Catering Companies Melbourne'. It is excluded here under the expansion rule and is the only one of the 20 allocation candidates not carried into seeds.json. Phase 5 needs a replacement for that slot — 'caterers melbourne' (2,900/mo, GSC pos 6.01) and 'best catering companies melbourne' (GSC pos 1.66, 346 impr) are the closest additive substitutes.

SILO DISCREPANCY: allocation.json places 'buffet catering melbourne' in tier_a_functions_events_head, but the Phase-1 brief defines buffet as a tier_c_food_packages_at_home term. Phase 1 followed the brief and assigned it to tier C. Phase 5 should reconcile before final selection — it moves one slot between tier budgets.

The 'melbourne' city modifier is treated as non-differentiating against the tracked 50: a candidate that is a tracked keyword plus/minus a bare 'melbourne' token is rejected as a duplicate (this is what removes 'drop off catering melbourne', 'office party catering melbourne', 'corporate party catering melbourne'). 'melbourne cbd' IS treated as differentiating, so 'catering melbourne cbd' survives against tracked 'catering melbourne'.
